description: Returns the status of a NumeroClaw reading order. Use it when the person asks whether their order is paid or their reading is ready. Inputs: orderId and orderToken, both returned when the order is created. Returns the status (awaiting_payment, expired, paid, queued, processing, completed or failed), the amount, the payment link while the order is unpaid, how long it usually takes while it is being written, and a short message for the person. The reading itself is sent only by email, to the address given with the order. A reading that is still being written has not failed: it is usually ready within a few hours and always within 6 hours. A failed status means the reading could not be produced and the payment will be refunded after a person at NumeroClaw reviews it.

orderId.description: The order id returned when the order was created.

orderToken.description: The private order token returned when the order was created.

name: get_order
title: Get a NumeroClaw order
